sites.boundary: Old-review handler: the provider queues the SDK's boolean review requests (useSafeTx, bridge, collector and launch reviews) into the one review dialog. Removed when those paths move to core (K4).
Creates the wagmi write useSafeTx sends with; the write below runs only inside submitReviewedContractWrite after the review and simulation. Deleted with useSafeTx in K3.

useSafeTx's one wallet write: submitReviewedContractWrite's write callback, sent from the simulated request after the review, the reviewed-wallet check and the write hold. Moves to sendReviewed in K3.
eth_getLogs on a Center public client: a log scan, never a wallet RPC.
The page reader's transport adds the page's abort signal to each public RPC read; never a wallet RPC.
eth_blockNumber on the page reader: a public read of the head, never a wallet RPC.
eth_call on a public client with a return-size cap: a read, never a wallet RPC.
navigator.locks.request on the sticky-reward-bridge lock: cross-tab bridge coordination, never a wallet RPC.
navigator.locks.request on the bridge record storage lock: cross-tab storage coordination, never a wallet RPC.
eth_getLogs on the source chain's public client to find queued bridge leaves: a read, never a wallet RPC.
The launch's deployStickyFor: submitReviewedContractWrite's write callback, sent from the simulated request after the launch's one review and the reviewed-wallet check. Moves to sendReviewed in K3.
The legacy Relayr execution payment: submitReviewedContractWrite's write callback, sent after its review, the reviewed-wallet check and the payment snapshot check. Moves to runRelayrReviewed in K3.
The Juicebox Center listing message, signed by the wallet that prepared the launch after the reviewed-wallet check. Moves to signReviewed in K3.
navigator.locks.request on the sticky-launch-write lock: cross-tab launch coordination, never a wallet RPC.
The Signa connector's read callback forwards public reads to the Center RPC transport for Base; Signa's own wallet signs and refuses writes here.
